locator.section: Article title; preceding journal citation identifies 2018Jan25;15(2):206, DOI10.3390/ijerph15020206; author list starts LiyeZou

correction: IJERPH2018;15(2):206 is the paper by Zou, Yeung, Quan, Boyden and Wang, DOI10.3390/ijerph15020206, on exercise, musculoskeletal pain and sleep. Its original article metadata and MDPI-deposited Crossref record agree. The Nienhaus author/title and these journal coordinates cannot identify the same article as printed. The intended replacement reference has not been established.
effect: The printed citation cannot be used to locate the infection-prevention study that the author invokes for its exposure-record argument. Correcting the bibliography would remove this source-identity error. No claim is made that a different, correctly identified Nienhaus paper could not support the general argument.
limits: This is a bibliographic identity error, not proof that long-term exposure registers lack value, that the underlying occupational-health propositions are false, or that no such study exists anywhere. No inference about intention or how the error arose. A clerical conflation or incorrectly copied reference remains plausible. No actual author response or specialist review.
materiality_explanation: Minor. The mismatch frustrates verification of one supporting reference, but no change to a quantitative policy effect or the desirability of exposure records has been demonstrated. It does not justify major severity.
context_and_alternatives: Both author pages were read in full and physical2 was rendered and visually checked. Section4 expressly supports exposure-data transfer and invokes Nienhaus2018 after the surrounding occupational-disease discussion. The reference has no DOI. A mistaken journal location, mistaken title, or blended citation are benign explanations, but they do not make the printed bibliographic combination accurate. The original Zou article header, author list, abstract, introduction and methods were read; no full clinical reappraisal is asserted.
